title: Resume and CV Writing & Optimisation
customer_problem: Your current CV is unclear, task-heavy or no longer represents your experience.
work_and_deliverable: Review the source document and target direction; verify facts; refine structure, language, evidence and agreed Word/PDF files.
publish_gate: Preserve the existing page and use it as the parent service.

title: Executive Resume Writing
customer_problem: Your senior remit, governance exposure and enterprise decisions are difficult to communicate in a conventional CV.
work_and_deliverable: Translate verified leadership scope, decisions, team or portfolio context and attributable evidence into an executive resume.
publish_gate: Keep under the existing resume service until distinct executive deliverables and demand are validated.

title: Senior Leadership CV
customer_problem: Your experience spans functions or business units and reads like a list of responsibilities rather than leadership evidence.
work_and_deliverable: Clarify remit, decision rights, operating context, scale and supported outcomes for senior-role audiences.
publish_gate: Use as a specialist section or audience example within the resume page.

title: Board and Non-Executive Director CV
customer_problem: Your executive CV does not show governance experience, committee contribution or oversight perspective clearly.
work_and_deliverable: Prepare a board-focused career record using verified governance, committee, risk, strategy and oversight evidence.
publish_gate: Publish only after confirming board-CV expertise, deliverables and a distinct audience-specific brief.

title: Clinical and Healthcare CV
customer_problem: Your clinical work, specialties, credentials and patient-care responsibilities are hard to present clearly to a specific healthcare audience.
work_and_deliverable: Structure clinical experience and verified credentials using terminology and conventions appropriate to the intended jurisdiction and role.
publish_gate: Do not publish until healthcare terminology expertise, credential handling and jurisdiction limits are verified.

title: Medical CV
customer_problem: Your medical training, clinical appointments, research and professional credentials need a clearer career record.
work_and_deliverable: Organise medical education, appointments, specialties, research and verified professional registrations for the target use.
publish_gate: Treat as a clinical-CV subtopic until specialist experience and requirements are verified.

title: Academic CV
customer_problem: Your academic record includes teaching, research, publications, grants or service that a standard resume cannot show properly.
work_and_deliverable: Organise academic appointments, research, publications, teaching, grants and service according to the institution or opportunity.
publish_gate: Validate academic CV requirements and source quality before creating a standalone page.

title: Technology and Engineering Resume
customer_problem: Your technical contribution is buried in tool lists or project descriptions without showing scope and decisions.
work_and_deliverable: Present systems, architecture, delivery, technical leadership, projects and attributable contribution accurately.
publish_gate: Use a technical example under the resume service unless a repeatable specialist process is proven.

title: Finance Professional Resume
customer_problem: Your finance experience is difficult to distinguish across reporting, planning, controls, investment or business-partner responsibilities.
work_and_deliverable: Clarify financial remit, controls, decision support, systems, stakeholders and permitted evidence.
publish_gate: Keep within resume writing; avoid implying accounting, investment or regulatory advice.

title: Project Management Resume
customer_problem: Your project history lists activities but does not explain complexity, governance, delivery responsibility or your contribution.
work_and_deliverable: Structure project scope, role, stakeholders, delivery approach, constraints and verified outcomes.
publish_gate: Use examples within the resume service; separate page only if unique scope is validated.

title: Career-Change Resume
customer_problem: Your previous experience does not obviously connect with the function or industry you now want to enter.
work_and_deliverable: Map transferable evidence and reposition the career narrative without claiming experience you do not have.
publish_gate: Covered by resume writing and career positioning; maintain one integrated customer journey.

title: Return-to-Work Resume
customer_problem: A career break or non-linear history makes it difficult to present your current readiness and earlier experience fairly.
work_and_deliverable: Organise chronology, relevant evidence, refreshed skills and a concise, truthful explanation where appropriate.
publish_gate: Keep as a specialist scenario under the resume service; no assumptions about why a break occurred.

title: International CV Adaptation
customer_problem: A document written for one market may not communicate clearly to readers in another.
work_and_deliverable: Review language, structure and local conventions using the target market and current employer instructions.
publish_gate: Verify country-specific knowledge and prohibit universal claims about CV conventions.

title: Target-Role Resume Tailoring
customer_problem: A general CV does not make the most relevant evidence visible for a particular opportunity.
work_and_deliverable: Compare the supplied role requirements with verified experience and prepare an agreed targeted version.
publish_gate: Already within resume writing; distinct page only if the engagement has a defined repeatable scope.

title: Job-Description Resume Alignment
customer_problem: You are unsure which parts of a job description genuinely match your experience.
work_and_deliverable: Review requirements, identify supported evidence, expose gaps and align language without copying or inventing qualifications.
publish_gate: Keep as an optional component of targeted resume work; do not promise ATS passage.

title: Master CV Development
customer_problem: Your experience is scattered across old CVs, role descriptions and project notes.
work_and_deliverable: Build a verified source document that can support later, agreed role-specific versions.
publish_gate: Confirm master-CV deliverables, revision policy and pricing basis before separate publication.

title: ATS Readability Review
customer_problem: Your resume uses formatting or structure that may be difficult for some application systems to parse.
work_and_deliverable: Review document structure, headings, text flow and common parsing risks, then explain practical corrections.
publish_gate: Keep under resume optimisation; never guarantee ATS acceptance, ranking or interview.

title: Resume Refresh and Rewrite
customer_problem: Your current CV has outdated roles, unclear progression or inconsistent information.
work_and_deliverable: Update career chronology, responsibilities, evidence and presentation using information confirmed by the client.
publish_gate: Covered by the canonical resume page.

customer_problem: A skills-led format may help organise experience when chronology is not the clearest starting point.
work_and_deliverable: Explain the format's trade-offs and organise verified competencies alongside transparent career history.
publish_gate: Keep as an educational section, not a separate service page by default.

title: Combination Resume Format
customer_problem: You need a balance between a skills-led opening and a clear employment chronology.
work_and_deliverable: Combine a relevant skills summary with evidence and a readable career history.
publish_gate: Keep as an educational section, not a separate service page by default.
